summary: Period 6 update covering 2020 (2020-01-01 to 2020-12-31): added 22 primary protein GWAS studies (18 published, 4 active preprints; upgraded mirauta_2018_ppr58348 to mirauta_2020_32773033, ruffieux_2019_ppr67785 to ruffieux_2020_32492067, ruotsalainen_2019_ppr104615 to ruotsalainen_2020_33110245, and gilly_2019_ppr103716 to gilly_2020_33303764), 28 strata, and 21,554 protein-assay records; cumulative totals: 73 studies, 88 strata, 59 cohorts, and 51,489 protein-assay records (11,507 unique human UniProt targets).

Period 2 update covering 2016 (2016-01-01 to 2016-12-31): added 7 primary protein GWAS studies (6 published, 1 active preprint), 11 strata, and 2,771 protein-assay records; cumulative totals: 21 studies, 27 strata, 20 cohorts, and 4,983 protein-assay records (2,243 unique human UniProt targets).
Initial public release covering Period 1 (2000-01-01 to 2015-12-31): 14 primary protein GWAS studies, 16 strata, 10 cohorts, and 2,212 protein-assay records (1,465 unique human UniProt targets).
